title: eXc Compass
description: A clean rotating compass bar at the top of your screen. Shows cardinal directions and exact degrees, turns smoothly with your view, styled in a turquoise to purple gradient.
body:
A clean, lightweight compass bar that sits at the top of your screen and rotates
smoothly as you look around. Always know which way you are facing — with cardinal
directions and exact degrees, wrapped in a turquoise-to-purple look.
